responsibility: Declares miscellaneous shared utility functions for the COBOL front end, especially diagnostics and small parser-support helpers. It exposes error/message entry points, character-class wrappers, preprocessor option and source-location save/restore helpers, size-printing support, and a tiny pointer-casting template used across the module.
same_name_distinction: Declares only the small cross-module utility interface—diagnostic entry points, character wrappers, source-location helpers, and a casting template—whereas util.cc also houses the larger internal utility implementations and COBOL keyword tables.
